Sign In toggle-class#toggle"> About the Business The subscription platform offers a space for self-published authors to obtain genuine reviews on their Amazon books. Members review others' books to earn points, which they can then spend to garner reviews for their own titles. Since its inception in 2025, this service has facilitated over 18,000 reviews and accumulated more than 450 paying members. The platform operates with minimal owner involvement, approximately five hours per week, focusing on member communication. A virtual assistant manages daily operations, including data handling and member email dispatches. Marketing efforts have been minimal, allowing significant potential for growth through paid promotions and partnerships, particularly within the self-publishing community. Key aspects include a high 70%+ net margin, a low refund rate, and an organic traffic source, primarily unpaid. Subscription revenue, enhanced by optional points bundles and featured book spot-upsells, accounts for the majority of its income. Despite its robust foundation, member engagement and content marketing opportunities remain largely untapped. The owner, identifying as more of a builder than a marketer, seeks to sell due to project redirection. They offer support after the transition to ensure member continuation. The assets involved include the platform's domain, source code, Stripe account, and member databases. Future growth avenues include expanded marketing strategies, optimizing member pricing, and leveraging necessary upsells. The business requires minimal maintenance, typically a few hours monthly for infrastructure monitoring and customer queries. Potential growth strategies include renewed marketing efforts, partnerships with web agencies, offering managed hosting or support packages, modernizing the platform's experience, or integrating AI features. Sign In toggle-class#toggle"> About the Business An anonymous technology firm has developed an automated algorithm to enhance pricing strategies across four marketplaces. This BuyBox algorithm adjusts prices dynamically based on competitor data while adhering to user-defined minimum and maximum price limits. Offered as a Software as a Service (SaaS), the platform utilizes a recurring billing model. Key financial figures reveal a four-month income of $11,250 against expenses of $870 and a 12-month income of $20,783 with expenses amounting to $3,000. The algorithm is unique in its capability to optimize product pricing in response to competitive data, aiming to maximize sales. All customers are based in the EU, and the average income per customer stands at $150 monthly. The service operates on a flexible, unlimited pay-as-you-go pricing system and can potentially expand to other marketplaces. Operationally, the system collects product pricing information based on user settings for each category, allowing different data collection frequencies. It takes approximately two hours weekly to maintain the system, particularly if data collection needs adaptation. The customer base consists entirely of EU legal entities, particularly e-commerce store owners using specific marketplaces. Customer acquisition strategies have predominantly involved email marketing. A significant service upgrade in September 2024 transitioned all users to unlimited pay-as-you-go plans, optimizing costs and growing monthly income from $1,250 to $2,800. Technologically, the service uses PHP Laravel for its backend, supported by a cloud infrastructure incorporating services like object storage and managed databases. Stripe manages payments and subscriptions. The potential audience for this service includes around 4,000 untapped prospects, with plans to adapt the algorithm for broader marketplace use. The business operates on a recurring revenue model, with clients paying annual subscriptions upfront and one-time device setup fees. It serves 18 active clients, including GP surgeries, locum staffing agencies, and individual locum GPs. Operations require less than three hours a week, with AI-assisted communication and no physical office or inventory, resulting in minimal fixed costs and high-profit margins on recurring revenue. Since its launch in January 2024, client retention has been strong, with only 1-2 clients lost. The company sees growth potential through partnerships with locum GP recruitment agencies. It encompasses both legal entities, brand, domain, website, client relationships, and proprietary provisioning tooling. The company's laptops enable locum GPs to securely access NHS clinical systems from any location via a secure VPN. Revenue streams include device setup fees at £979 per device and annual tech support subscriptions at £69.99 per user. The client base is acquired through direct outreach, LinkedIn, word of mouth, and organic search and consists solely of UK-based entities. The business is operated under two legal entities without external funding. Financial records indicate around £29,700 in client revenue for March 2025-2026, with inter-company transfers managed between two accounts. Key assets included in the business sale encompass the brand, domain, website, client relationships, and proprietary provisioning tools. This utility app transforms iPhones into precise decibel meters, attracting a diverse user base from hobbyists to professionals, providing both free and premium features to enhance user experience and remove ads. The subscription-based monetization includes weekly, monthly, and lifetime options managed through a transfer-ready platform. The app benefits from consistent income, minimal maintenance, and automated paid acquisition campaigns. The independent developer and entrepreneur behind the app, based in Spain, has been responsible for its development and marketing strategies, ensuring stable performance but highlighting several untapped growth opportunities. Featuring native iOS and Android applications developed on a modern Flutter codebase, the platform is scalable and has been refined with an investment exceeding $100,000. It boasts a unique therapist matching system, extensive onboarding flow, and proprietary management tools tailored for relationship therapy, carving a niche away from broader mental health services. While this marketplace is mature with recurring customers generating monthly revenue organically, it presents immense opportunities for expansion. Potential growth avenues include international expansion, AI-driven therapy features, corporate wellness integrations, and a bolstered digital marketing strategy encompassing SEO content and digital cross-selling. Operations involve therapist discovery and matching, AI-assisted recommendations, secure booking, and hosting of video therapy sessions, supplemented by a rich library of educational content. Revenue is primarily commission-based on completed sessions, with operations manageable at around 10–15 hours weekly covering customer support and marketing oversight, among other tasks. With approximately 6,000 registered users, the platform ceases paid advertising yet continues to attract organic users and maintain revenue primarily from returning clientele. This consistent client engagement underscores the business's attractive customer lifetime value. Sign In toggle-class#toggle"> About the Business The sale of a digital project includes a comprehensive package involving native iOS and Android source codes, a React JS admin interface, a machine learning-powered matching engine, and a GraphQL API. Additional assets are a website developed in VueJS, multiple domain names, social media pages, a Tunetoo merchandise shop, and a WordPress blog. The platform, whose social media accounts boast a few thousand followers, offers a fresh perspective on online dating by fostering meaningful interactions through mutual friends' recommendations. The app aims to bring together people in a less superficial manner than conventional dating apps by relying on the trusted circles of acquaintances. While it currently does not generate revenue, the primary focus has been on growing its user base. The estimated operational cost is $100 per month for its infrastructure. Marketing efforts thus far have involved influencers, Instagram, and Facebook ads, promotional videos, and live events. The solo entrepreneur behind the project wishes to pass the torch to a vibrant team that can build on their groundwork. The app allows users to take on roles like a "Chappy" or a "Chaperon," promoting inter-friend connections through match predictions and votes. While "Chaperons" help connect compatible friends, "Chappies" receive matches and can switch roles, enriching their dating experience.
